name: year-split team stat anchors a multi-year offset window to each row's own year (executed-result parity)
description: A year split renders one cell per (player, year), and a year_offset range asks each of those cells for a window relative to ITS OWN year -- row 2023 with offset [1,2] means 2024+2025, row 2024 means 2025+2026. The team family's main_select_string_year_offset_range correlates only on the subject key with no year predicate, so every row instead receives the whole offset-expanded window pooled together and all four rows render the same number. The generic offset-range branch in select-string.mjs already emits the year predicate this override was missing. The seed gives each season a distinct team pass-yard total (2024 -> 10, 2025 -> 200, 2026 -> 3000) so the pooled answer and the per-row answers cannot coincide: anchored the rows read 210 / 3200 / 3000 / null, pooled they all read 3210. 2023 carries 7 yards that no row's window should ever reach, so dropping the offset entirely is also visible rather than silent.
